nodes.label: Bank Transfers FAQ
nodes.content: Money transfers take 1-3 business days domestic, up to 5 days international. Daily transfer limit is EUR 10,000. Schedule future-dated transfers via online banking or the app. SEPA transfers within EU are free.

nodes.label: Credit Score FAQ
nodes.content: Improve credit score: pay all bills on time, keep credit utilisation below 30%, avoid multiple credit applications within 6 months, maintain long-standing credit accounts. Score updates monthly with your bank.

nodes.label: Fraud Reporting FAQ
nodes.content: Report fraud immediately: freeze card in the app or call 1800-123-456. Disputes resolved within 5 business days. Temporary credit issued during investigation. Keep dispute reference number safe.

nodes.label: Travel Policy FAQ
nodes.content: Notify bank before international travel to prevent card blocks. Purchase travel insurance before departure date. Carry-on luggage limit 10kg. Check visa requirements 6-8 weeks before travel. EHIC card covers EU medical emergencies.

nodes.label: Hotel Booking FAQ
nodes.content: Free cancellation up to 48 hours before check-in. Standard check-in 3pm, check-out 11am. Early check-in subject to availability. Breakfast included only when pre-booked. Loyalty points on all stays.

nodes.label: PTO Policy FAQ
nodes.content: PTO requests require 5 business days advance notice via HR portal. Annual allowance is 25 days. Unused days beyond 5 do not roll over. Emergency same-day leave requires manager approval. Parental and sick leave are separate entitlements.

nodes.label: Medication Guidance FAQ
nodes.content: Never skip prescribed medication without consulting your GP. Set daily alarms at the same time. Keep a dose log in your health app. Store in cool dry place away from direct sunlight. Repeat prescriptions available every 28 days from your pharmacy.

nodes.label: Vegetarian Gluten-Free Diet FAQ
nodes.content: Balanced vegetarian gluten-free diet: chickpeas, lentils, beans for protein; leafy greens for iron and calcium; brown rice, quinoa, buckwheat for carbohydrates; nuts and seeds for healthy fats. Aim for 25g fibre daily.

nodes.label: Car Maintenance FAQ
nodes.content: Oil change every 5,000-7,500 miles or every 6 months. Check tyre pressure monthly. Annual NCT required in Ireland for cars over 4 years. Full service covers brakes, fluids, air filter, battery, belts. Road tax renewed annually.

nodes.label: What Jarvis Can Do

Capabilities: banking (balance, transfers, fraud), travel (flights, hotels, documents), health (medication, appointments, fitness), calendar (schedule, reminders, alarms), work (PTO, meetings, tasks), education (course deadlines, study reminders), lifestyle (restaurants, commute, home devices, music, food orders).
